description: Compact C/A/M top HUD radio and mute; retire Original/Hoodie and prevent legacy avatar flash; offset persisted artwork away from wall/floor surfaces and correct artwork inspection matrix.
notes: Radio reuses the existing LiveRadioController. C/A/M are Chillhop/Alternative/Metal; paused or unavailable shows a grey dash; speaker resumes last station.

Original and Hoodie remain accepted legacy IDs in types/old data but are removed from player selection. Previously saved Original/Hoodie selections migrate to Casual Male; other choices and saves remain.
Previous imported character remains visible while a newly selected GLB loads; the old procedural avatar is never shown as a placeholder.

Persisted artwork remains parented to canonical wall. Overlay world-normal gap increased to 7cm without changing server transforms or stored data. This is a clipping mitigation pending on-device validation.
Regression tests updated in GitHub, not included in the Aippy runtime manifest.
No server modifications, no package changes, no changes to Aippy host or importer.
